required_elements: public or clearly labeled historical source
policy.private_aggregate_rule: Private operating totals do not appear in recruiter-facing public copy unless the underlying evidence can be safely published and independently reviewed.
policy.historical_record_rule: A retained version, digest, or originating check may be described as a historical record, but it is not current public test coverage when the exact artifact cannot be inspected or rerun.
policy.configuration_limit_rule: Timeouts, caps, quantities, and protocol floors are described as configured controls, not measured performance.
policy.headline_rule: A headline number must be publicly traceable, professionally relevant, explicitly defined, and accompanied by its main limitation.

repositories.display_name: Portfolio governance and Reliable Project Delivery Framework
repositories.guide_heading: ## Portfolio governance and Reliable Project Delivery Framework
repositories.core_claim: The public portfolio is managed as a governed source system whose project entries are tied to the version and exact GitHub commit actually present.
repositories.talk_track: I manage the public portfolio as a governed source system. Each project is tied to the version and exact GitHub commit that is actually present, and newer packages are not claimed when their source cannot be verified.
limitations: The ledger does not mean every project has equal maturity, external adoption, production deployment, or physical-machine acceptance.
readme_required_markers: 17 public projects reconciled to exact GitHub source
Public project release reconciliation
Public dependency reconciliation

quantitative_claims.label: 17 public projects reconciled to exact GitHub source
quantitative_claims.definition: Seventeen public project records, excluding the profile repository and two private workspaces.
quantitative_claims.why_it_matters: Demonstrates version and source governance across the public project portfolio.
quantitative_claims.limitation: Does not imply equal project maturity, usage, commercial adoption, or deployment.

repositories.core_claim: A local Windows operations console that distinguishes fresh discovery from retained registry evidence and rechecks launcher and process identity before project-scoped control.
repositories.talk_track: BotOps Manager is a local Windows console that discovers candidate automation projects, preserves prior registry evidence when a scan is incomplete, and rechecks launcher and process identity before it permits a project-scoped control action.
limitations: It does not guarantee discovery of inaccessible folders, control every process beneath a root, administer remote machines, or prove child application logic safe.
readme_required_markers: When a scan is incomplete, it preserves the prior registry rather than silently replacing it
historical discovery evidence, not proof that the projects were freshly observed
Stale discovery data and persisted PIDs are never accepted on their own as authority to act.
readme_forbidden_markers: BotOps can observe every project beneath its configured root

repositories.core_claim: A deterministic read-only catalog audit that turns schema, provenance, confidence, and duplicate signals into an ordered human review queue.
repositories.talk_track: This is a read-only catalog audit that turns schema, provenance, confidence, and duplicate signals into an ordered human review queue without changing the source catalog.
limitations: Fixture metrics are synthetic and do not represent a production catalog, universal DAM standard, retention decision, or automatic remediation result.
readme_required_markers: These are fixture results, not claims about a production catalog.
The tool never changes the catalog.
Queue priority organizes human review; it is not a retention decision

quantitative_claims.label: 8-record deterministic fixture
quantitative_claims.definition: Eight synthetic records intentionally cover valid, incomplete-provenance, missing-checksum, confidence, and duplicate-review paths.
quantitative_claims.why_it_matters: Shows that each audit path is deterministic and reviewable.
quantitative_claims.limitation: The percentages and queue counts are fixture outputs, not production catalog KPIs.

repositories.core_claim: A local-first media workflow where evidence proposes matches and complete-scan, confidence, ambiguity, dry-run, journal, verification, and rollback controls govern writes.
repositories.talk_track: MediaTaggerBot uses public metadata and local evidence to propose media matches, but complete-scan, confidence, ambiguity, dry-run, journal, readback, and rollback controls determine whether a file can be changed.
limitations: The public repository does not prove a correction rate across a private library, guarantee provider accuracy, or make apply-all safe for unattended use.
readme_required_markers: this repository does not present private aggregate counts as independently verifiable performance evidence
Public claims are limited to behavior that can be reviewed in this source
Uncertain files remain visible for review instead of being forced into a best guess.

repositories.core_claim: A reproducible descriptive analysis comparing inspection outcomes and facility-risk classifications across three Chicago ZIP codes.
repositories.talk_track: I used a reproducible notebook and a bounded City of Chicago dataset snapshot to compare inspection outcomes with facility-risk classifications across three ZIP codes. The main finding is that the two measures can point in different directions.
limitations: One row is an inspection rather than a unique establishment; the three ZIP codes are not representative of all Chicago; the analysis is descriptive rather than causal.
readme_required_markers: Across 13,333 inspection records
Each row represents an inspection, not a unique establishment.
The questions are descriptive. They do not support a ranking of restaurant safety or a causal interpretation.

quantitative_claims.label: 13,333 public inspection records across three Chicago ZIP codes
quantitative_claims.definition: Inspection records dated January 5, 2010 through June 13, 2018 in ZIP codes 60607, 60610, and 60622; one row is an inspection.
quantitative_claims.why_it_matters: Shows reproducible public-data analysis and why outcome and facility-risk measures must be interpreted separately.
quantitative_claims.limitation: The selected ZIP codes do not represent all Chicago, facilities can appear more than once, and the analysis is not causal.

repositories.core_claim: A local-first telemetry supervisor that classifies device health and permits reboot recovery only after repeated critical evidence, two independent gates, identity checks, and durable budget reservation.
repositories.talk_track: This project converts local miner telemetry into explicit health states and allows reboot recovery only after repeated critical evidence, two operator-controlled gates, identity checks, and a durable restart-budget reservation.
limitations: Publication testing used synthetic protocol responses; no live Avalon Q reboot was executed from the publication environment; it is not a profitability model or security certification.
readme_required_markers: Actual reboot recovery has two independent gates:
No live Avalon Q was reachable from the publication environment.
This is an operational reliability demonstration, not a profitability model or mining recommendation.

quantitative_claims.label: two independent recovery gates
quantitative_claims.definition: Recovery requires both recovery.enabled=true in local configuration and the runtime --execute flag.
quantitative_claims.why_it_matters: Demonstrates explicit separation between monitoring and state-changing authority.
quantitative_claims.limitation: The gates reduce accidental activation but are not evidence of live-device recovery success.

repositories.core_claim: Three documentation-only studies of reconciliation and bounded recovery across exchange, process-supervision, and authorized-media-transfer boundaries.
repositories.talk_track: These are three design studies showing how a controller should reconcile authoritative state before retrying across exchange, process-supervision, and media-transfer boundaries.
limitations: The repository contains no deployable integrations and does not demonstrate production trading, mining, transfer activity, profitability, endorsement, or regulatory approval.
readme_required_markers: Three engineering analyses
The scenarios are synthetic, and the repository contains no deployable integrations.
These studies do not claim production use

quantitative_claims.label: three engineering analyses
quantitative_claims.definition: Three public design studies: exchange reconciliation, compute-worker supervision, and authorized-media transfer.
quantitative_claims.why_it_matters: Shows the same reliability reasoning applied across distinct system boundaries.
quantitative_claims.limitation: Three is a document count, not a deployment count.

repositories.core_claim: A working local browser-RPG vertical slice with layered logic, validated catalogs, revision-safe saves, loopback-only delivery, and public v0.4.11 source tests.
repositories.talk_track: Beta Earth is a working local browser-RPG vertical slice with layered domain logic, validated content, revision-safe saves, a loopback-only interface, and source-portability tests on the public v0.4.11 tree.
limitations: The public source is v0.4.11; v0.5.0 is a recorded historical final whose exact archive is unavailable; the project is not a complete or hosted game and hosted CI is not physical-machine acceptance.
readme_required_markers: Current public source authority: `0.4.11`
Because the exact archive is unavailable, those checks cannot be rerun from this repository
not presented as current public test coverage

quantitative_claims.label: six-room Sprawl 15 scenario
quantitative_claims.definition: The public v0.4.11 vertical slice includes a six-room scenario and the listed gameplay systems.
quantitative_claims.why_it_matters: Makes the current public product scope concrete.
quantitative_claims.limitation: It is a vertical slice, not a complete game.

quantitative_claims.label: v0.5.0 recorded successor
quantitative_claims.definition: A newer final identity and SHA-256 are retained in a public issue, but the exact archive is unavailable.
quantitative_claims.why_it_matters: Preserves lineage without relabeling older public source.
quantitative_claims.limitation: Originating checks cannot be rerun and are not current public test coverage.

repositories.core_claim: An authorized-media workflow whose GUI and CLI share planning, public-network checks, duplicate controls, isolated execution, recovery, and final validation.
repositories.talk_track: This is an authorized-media retrieval workflow whose GUI and CLI share the same planning, public-network checks, duplicate controls, isolated worker, interruption recovery, and final output validation.
limitations: It does not determine legal authorization, bypass access controls, guarantee extractor compatibility, or create a complete SSRF isolation boundary.
readme_required_markers: A five-second no-progress watchdog
This project does not guarantee that a URL is lawful to download
Public-network preflight is a defense-in-depth check

quantitative_claims.label: five-second no-progress watchdog
quantitative_claims.definition: A silent worker is terminated after five seconds without progress, while resumable partial files are preserved and the watchdog disarms for post-processing.
quantitative_claims.why_it_matters: Shows bounded hang detection and recovery behavior.
quantitative_claims.limitation: It is a failure-detection threshold, not a promise that a download completes in five seconds.

repositories.core_claim: A controlled one-URL audio workflow with metadata preflight, bounded recovery, output validation, duplicate reconciliation, and restricted support exports.
repositories.talk_track: MP3 Downloader turns one authorized URL into a validated audio-only result through metadata preflight, bounded recovery, output checks, duplicate reconciliation, and tightly limited support exports.
limitations: Metadata preflight cannot prove ownership; the URL guard is not a complete SSRF boundary; extractor compatibility depends on upstream sites and the pinned dependency.
readme_required_markers: A reachable URL or finished transfer alone is not treated as proof of a usable result.
This preflight is **not an SSRF containment boundary**.
The deterministic test suite does not contact websites

repositories.core_claim: A permissioned-image workflow with bounded discovery and provisional transfers that must pass destination, type, size, decode, duplicate, and integrity checks before atomic finalization.
repositories.talk_track: Image Downloader collects permitted images through bounded page discovery and provisional transfers that must pass destination, type, size, decode, duplicate, and integrity checks before atomic finalization.
limitations: It is not a crawler, archival guarantee, permission detector, or complete hostile-network isolation boundary; browser mode is not an authentication bypass.
readme_required_markers: A strict five-second per-image network budget
this is defense in depth rather than a complete isolation boundary
this is not a crawler or archival guarantee

quantitative_claims.label: five-second per-image network budget
quantitative_claims.definition: The per-image budget covers HEAD preflight, GET attempts, bounded backoff, reconnects, and streamed transfer; discovery has a separate limit.
quantitative_claims.why_it_matters: Demonstrates an end-to-end request deadline rather than unbounded retries.
quantitative_claims.limitation: It is a deadline control, not a speed or completion guarantee.

repositories.core_claim: A local text utility that separates readable overlap from raw boundaries so normalized source text can be reconstructed and hash-verified.
repositories.talk_track: Large Text Chunker separates readable overlap from raw source boundaries so chunks can retain context while the normalized source can still be reconstructed and hash-verified exactly.
limitations: Exact reconstruction applies to normalized text, token values are estimates, and the missing v1.10.0 archive is not current public source.
readme_required_markers: Current public source authority: `1.0.0`
The built-in token value is an estimate, not a model-specific billing count.
Input newlines are normalized to `LF`

quantitative_claims.label: v1.10.0 recorded successor
quantitative_claims.definition: A checksum companion records the successor identity, but the exact ZIP is unavailable.
quantitative_claims.why_it_matters: Preserves release lineage while keeping v1.0.0 as honest public source.
quantitative_claims.limitation: The unavailable successor cannot be promoted or treated as inspectable public source.

repositories.core_claim: A read-only Windows diagnostic that correlates bounded gateway, route, DNS, TCP, latency, event, and optional trace evidence for support triage.
repositories.talk_track: NetLossDoctor collects time-bounded Windows network evidence across gateway, route, DNS, TCP, latency, events, and optional captures so support can compare layers instead of relying on a single ping.
limitations: It is not an outage authority, packet-forensics platform, security audit, or replacement for ISP/vendor instrumentation; intermediate-hop ICMP loss alone is not proof of outage.
readme_required_markers: Its throughput is context, not a certified line-speed measurement.
The tool provides evidence for analysis; it does not replace vendor or ISP instrumentation.
The file in `examples/` is synthetic

repositories.core_claim: A cloud-free authenticated text and resumable file exchange protocol for two managed Windows computers on a trusted private network.
repositories.talk_track: LAN Router Comms provides authenticated text and resumable file exchange between two managed Windows computers on a trusted private network, with durable queues and hash receipts instead of blind resend behavior.
limitations: The protocol has not received independent security review, is not designed for internet exposure, and has no NAT traversal, cloud relay, non-Windows client, or remote shell.
readme_required_markers: Individual transfers are capped at 10 GiB.
This transparent PowerShell implementation has not received an independent security audit or formal protocol review.
This project is not designed for internet exposure.

quantitative_claims.label: 10 GiB individual transfer cap
quantitative_claims.definition: A configured admission limit for a single incoming transfer, combined with a free-space reserve.
quantitative_claims.limitation: It is not demonstrated throughput or a performance benchmark.

quantitative_claims.label: TLS 1.2 floor and RSA 2048-bit minimum
quantitative_claims.definition: Minimum accepted protocol and certificate-key constraints.
quantitative_claims.limitation: These constraints are not a formal protocol or security certification.

repositories.core_claim: A read-only, non-elevated, no-network endpoint snapshot that treats unavailable collectors as missing evidence and produces review prompts rather than remediation.
repositories.talk_track: Windows Health Audit returns one read-only, privacy-preserving endpoint snapshot and treats unavailable collectors as missing evidence rather than proof of failure.
limitations: It is a review aid rather than a diagnostic authority, benchmark, security scanner, monitoring service, or proof of endpoint health.
readme_required_markers: The script writes nothing.
An unavailable collector is treated as missing evidence, not as proof of endpoint failure.
checkout pinned to the reviewed immutable commit recorded in the workflow

repositories.core_claim: A static decision-driven browser game whose authored cases exercise branching state, progression, accessibility, resilient saves, and full-campaign testing.
repositories.talk_track: Inbox From Hell is a static browser game that uses branching support decisions to exercise persistent state, short- and long-term progression, accessible interaction, and a complete campaign test.
limitations: The counts describe inspectable product content, not players, downloads, retention, revenue, or validated training outcomes.

The test traverses a complete five-shift campaign

limitations: The heuristic is not a prediction model or market edge; verification is not a warranty or legal approval; orders may not fill, fees apply, and the full principal can be lost.

Those numbers describe one conditional payoff, not a forecast.

quantitative_claims.why_it_matters: Makes the educational build's order and principal boundary explicit.
quantitative_claims.limitation: It is not expected return, fill probability, or performance evidence.
